provenance.compiledBy: Oracle V1 bootstrap — NOT a verified rules ingestion
caveats: UNVERIFIED. This snapshot exists so the engine, its tests, and the interface can be exercised end to end. It must not be relied on for any real application.

Occupation rows — codes, titles, RQF levels and going rates — are ILLUSTRATIVE. They have not been read from Appendix Skilled Occupations against a primary source and several are approximations. Replace the entire occupations block before launch.

The general salary threshold (GBP 41,700), the RQF 6 floor effective 22 July 2025, and the CEFR B2 requirement effective 8 January 2026 are carried from NEXUS_V3.0_FINAL V2, which cites GOV.UK Immigration Rules. They are the most likely fields to be correct, and are still not independently verified here.
The hourly floor and the 48-hour pro-rating cap are carried from the V1 prototype and are unverified.
Tradeable-point definitions are structurally correct in shape but their percentages and eligibility bases must be checked against Appendix Skilled Worker before use.
Per NEXUS_V3.0_FINAL section 2: for anything driving a build decision, require who measured it, when, against what outcome. Nothing in this file meets that bar yet.
